xBRIEFInfo.description: Contain atomicWriteText, ritual-state, and probe-session writes to projectRoot (parent-as-root + bare write sinks).

plan.title: fix(security): projectRoot containment for atomicWriteText, ritual-state, probe-session (parent-as-root + bare write)

narratives.Description: Three residual Medium containment gaps after #2951/#2980: atomicWriteText parent-as-root, writeRitualState parent-as-root, writeSession bare open/write/rename. Contain all three against projectRoot and refuse escaping symlink parents.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive operator, I want lifecycle and ritual writes contained to projectRoot, so that force-added directory symlinks cannot divert product writes outside the checkout.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Edit packages/core/src/cache/io.ts (atomicWriteText) to contain against projectRoot via assertWriteTargetSafe or containedWrite root=projectRoot; edit packages/core/src/session/ritual-sentinel.ts writeRitualState the same way; edit packages/core/src/orchestration/probe-session.ts writeSession to drop bare open/write/rename. Add unit tests under matching *.test.ts that force-add xbrief/ and .deft/ dir symlinks and assert fail-closed. Run pnpm exec vitest on those packages and task check. Cite #3042 in CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Overview: projectRoot containment for three residual write sinks (cache/io atomicWriteText, ritual-sentinel, probe-session).
narratives.NonGoals: Full monorepo nested-root redesign; changing ritual/probe semantics beyond containment; reopening #2951 epic beyond these three sinks.

items.title: Contain three write sinks to projectRoot

narrative.Acceptance: Given a force-added directory symlink for xbrief/ or .deft/, when atomicWriteText, writeRitualState, or writeSession runs, the write is refused or contained so no file is created outside projectRoot.

Given the unit regression suite for cache/session/orchestration, when run, symlink-escape cases fail closed; verify:contained-writes (or equivalent inventory) does not list these three sinks as open product holes.
Given CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased], when the PR lands, it cites #3042 for the containment fix.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/cache packages/core/src/session packages/core/src/orchestration
swarm.missing_traces_justification: Issue body names the three sinks and remediation APIs; file_scope is the expected touch set from #3042 acceptance.
